headline: As of 2026-10-21: 17,067,566 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 45 of 50 states, D+15.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 17,067,566 early/mail ballots cast so far across 45 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+15.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,854,319), Florida (1,618,163), Texas (1,612,283).
